# Section [NN] Reflection — [Name]

Write the initial reflection yourself, in a natural first-person voice. Use AI afterward only to critique technical clarity or correct factual mistakes, unless you explicitly request editing.

- What surprised me when moving from Python/TypeScript to C?
- What was the hardest unfamiliar problem and how did I eventually solve it?
- Which algorithms or data structures did I choose, and why?
- What did I learn about memory layout, correctness, or performance?
- What bugs did I introduce, and what evidence helped me find them?
- If AI wrote similar code for a project, what would I now review differently?
- How does this connect to an existing project or a prior design decision?
- What do I want to revisit before I go further?
